trust_decision.summary: Strings in a reference manifest (refs URLs, templates, gen key/url/offset/length) are untrusted. ReferenceFileSystem decides whether they get evaluated as Jinja (unsandboxed jinja2.Template) or substituted as plain text. That choice is made in _process_references1/_process_templates/_process_gen, gated only partly by simple_templates.

landing_point.why: Someone who reads only 'SSTI in ReferenceFileSystem' would grep for jinja2.Template. The first hit is the _render_jinja helper used for refs URLs when simple_templates=False.

fix_sites.entry_point: fsspec.filesystem('reference', fo=<dict or JSON URL>, simple_templates=False): refs entries whose URL contains '{{'

fsspec.filesystem('reference', fo=...) with any simple_templates value: a 'templates' value (or template_overrides value) containing '{{' becomes a jinja lambda. __init__ calls it during remote-protocol inference (reference.py:748-752)
fix_sites.module_kind: filesystem implementation (template table builder; called from __init__ defaults route)

fix_sites.entry_point: fsspec.filesystem('reference', fo=...): 'gen' entries' key/url/offset/length. Before the fix this ran even with simple_templates=True (default)
same as gen route; the a1c16 gate inserted at the top of _process_gen (reference.py:1057-1058)
fsspec.filesystem('filecache'/'blockcache', cache_storage=...): loads the cache metadata file and falls back to pickle.load when it is not JSON
fix_sites.module_kind: caching layer (save/reload of metadata). Different weakness (CWE-502), bundled in the 'Small safety improvements' commit

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: fsspec/implementations/reference.py:1043-1055 executed via fsspec/implementations/reference.py:748-752 (remote_protocol default inference calls each callable template); template_overrides merged at fsspec/implementations/reference.py:1045-1046

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Templates look like plain substitution values, and the docstring says simple_templates=True means simple replace (reference.py:678-681). A solver who 'honours simple_templates' (as commit a1c16 does for gen) can argue the templates table is just data, and miss that __init__'s protocol inference renders it with jinja in every mode. The simple-mode str.format route (O8) can be dismissed as 'documented safe mode, format cannot call code'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate Jinja manifests must keep rendering when simple_templates=False: callable templates with kwargs ('{{f(c="text")}}'), arithmetic in gen offset ('{{(i + 1) * 1000}}'), and simple {{u}} replacement plus template_overrides in default mode. Removing jinja, or refusing callables or expressions, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: refs entry as a 1-element list [url] or a 3-element list [url, offset, length] with '{{' in url (reference.py:1027-1038)
templates value string containing '{{' (becomes a callable) vs plain string (reference.py:1047-1055)
gen entry fields key, url, offset, length rendered separately; dimensions as list or range dict (reference.py:1059-1083)
manifest passed as an in-memory dict vs a JSON file URL loaded via fsspec.open (reference.py:705-728)

O7_producer.where: fsspec/implementations/reference.py:1043-1055 (_process_templates turns manifest template strings into jinja-rendering lambdas, consumed at reference.py:750-752, 1018, 1075-1082)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Default 'safe' simple_templates mode substitutes refs URLs with str.format(**self.templates). An attacker-controlled format string gets attribute/index traversal on template values (e.g. a jinja lambda's __globals__, which holds module 'os'), so data leaks into the URL that is then fetched. The fix leaves this path untouched.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix's docstring calls simple mode 'the safe option' (fix.diff:552-553), and str.format cannot call functions, so it is information disclosure rather than RCE.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 20 lines above the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: LazyReferenceMapper._load_one_key expands '{{...}}' in parquet 'path' values against stored templates using jinja2.Template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Parquet refs are the lazy counterpart of JSON refs. A maintainer adding template support to the parquet backend would naturally copy the jinja call from _render_jinja. It sits at distance in a separate class that a solver focused on _process_references1 would not reopen.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: remote-protocol inference renders callable references (callable(ref) -> ref()) through a fresh unsandboxed jinja2.Template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The loop already calls callable references (reference.py:760-762); a lazily rendered ref helper would be a plausible optimisation.

O9_family: template injection / code injection (CWE-1336, CWE-94): untrusted manifest strings evaluated by an unsandboxed template engine

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -e . plus pytest; jinja2 optional dependency (imported lazily at reference.py:1012, 1049, 1073)
O10_build.project_tests: fsspec/implementations/tests/test_reference.py (test_spec1_expand :276, test_spec1_expand_simple :326, test_spec1_gen_variants :353); fsspec/implementations/tests/test_cached.py for the cache-metadata pickle site

j.j_sites_touched: fsspec/implementations/reference.py, fsspec/implementations/cache_metadata.py (plus non-security assert changes in fsspec/asyn.py, fsspec/implementations/dbfs.py)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap jinja2.Template for SandboxedEnvironment only in _render_jinja (refs, the report's example), or only gate _process_gen on simple_templates, leaving the templates lambdas that __init__ renders in every mode.

out_of_scope_notes: fsspec/implementations/cache_metadata.py:55-62 pickle.load fallback on cache metadata (CWE-502) was removed in the same fix commit, but it is a different protection. A fair task would need its own report line.
fsspec/implementations/reference.py:1022-1024 base64-decoded value is overwritten by the raw string (functional bug, not security).
fsspec/implementations/reference.py:1045-1046 template_overrides.update mutates the caller's manifest dict in place (not security).
unverified: Repo size not measured (no shell). fsspec is a small library and may meet tiny_repo (<5 MB source); not flagged because unmeasured. Lessons say small libraries never made a task hard.
O8 str.format leak is from reading only: format-spec traversal on a lambda's __globals__['os'] was not run. Whether it falls within the advisory's protection (RCE vs disclosure) is a judgement call.
O2/O7 classification (defaults route / 'mapper') is the closest enum fit for the templates table rendered by __init__ protocol inference.
All in-scope sites are in one file within about 350 lines, so distance is low; pattern A is weak and relies on the init-time templates route.
Advisory text itself was not available beyond the summary; latest release is 'none', so present_in_latest is unknown.
Whether SandboxedEnvironment still allows harmful calls on template lambdas exposed in the render context was not assessed.
